fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant was stopped on a stretch near Sindhu Puram Industrial Area by a few persons and a gold ring was taken. The matter was brought to Salem Town PS on 2026-05-07, while the incident was placed on 2026-05-07 around 20:25 hrs. Malathi Ammal approached Salem Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000345. Ajith Murugan (9000000225), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant could not identify the person involved. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-33-XX-1009 was seen leaving the area. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly followed the victim before stopping the vehicle.
fields.Keywords: highway robbery, roadside, associate, industrial area, motorcycle, evening, CCTV
